title: Rubber Logic
prompt: drum n bass, uk garage, fred again, joy orbison, skrillex
description: A bass-led garage crossover with a rubbery sawtooth bassline that bounces between octaves over a syncopated kick. Metallic percussion glints through sparse dark chords as the track builds to two festival-ready peaks with a moody valley between them. Dark but playful, pulling from Joy Orbison's floor instincts and Skrillex's restless energy.
